RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: agriculture
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Working the land and the herd: food, fibre, medicine, cash crops, timber.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: extraction
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Taking raw material out of the ground: ore, stone, fuel, salvage.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: manufacturing
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Turning raw material into goods: refining, building, textiles, arms, components, chemicals, food, power, fabrication.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: services
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Moving, selling, hosting, healing and teaching: trade, transport, hospitality, finance, healthcare, education.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: military
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: People under arms: garrisons, raiders, mercenaries.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: public
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Administration and belief: the people who run the place and the people who preach in it.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: food crops
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Staples: rice, potatoes, corn, berries. The floor under everything else.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: livestock
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Herding and ranching: meat, milk, eggs, wool and leather. Works on grazing land crops cannot use.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: fibre crops
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Cotton and devilstrand for cloth. Feeds the textile trade; no fibre, no clothing industry.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: medicinal crops
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Healroot for herbal medicine, and the raw plant stock the pharmaceutical labs refine.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: cash crops
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Smokeleaf, psychoid, hops, ambrosia: grown to sell, not to eat. High value, addictive end products, the raw side of the drug trade.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: forestry
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Timber. The construction and fuel material for anyone below industrial tech.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: mining
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Ore: steel, plasteel, gold, silver, uranium, jade. Reads the region's mineral pools.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: quarrying
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Stone chunks for blocks. Mountains and hills are the input.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: fuel
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Chemfuel from deep drilling, boomalope ranching and refineries. The energy input for industrial power and vehicles.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: salvage
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Scavenging ruins and wrecks for components and scrap. The raider and scavenger economy's extraction arm.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: refining and smelting
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Ore and scrap into usable metal.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: construction materials
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Stone blocks, timber and steel into walls and roofs. Feeds settlement growth directly.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: textiles and apparel
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Cloth, leather and wool into clothing. Tailoring benches.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: armaments
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Weapons and armour. Smithies at tribal tech, machining tables at industrial.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: components and electronics
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Industrial and advanced components. The bottleneck for every high-tech chain.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: pharmaceuticals
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Drug labs: medicine from herbal stock and neutroamine, penoxycyline, go-juice, wake-up. Industrial medicine depends on it.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: recreational drugs and alcohol
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Cash crops refined: smokeleaf joints, psychite tea, flake, yayo, beer. High margin, addictive, the demand side of the cash-crop trade.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: food processing
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Meals, pemmican, kibble, brewing and butchering. Stretches raw food into stored food.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: energy
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Power generation: wood and chemfuel burners, solar, wind, geothermal, watermills. Every industrial sub-sector consumes it.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: advanced fabrication
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Fabrication benches: bionics, advanced components, spacer gear, mechanoids with Biotech. The top of the tech tree.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: merchants and caravans
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Buying and selling across regions. Moves every other sector's surplus; brings in neutroamine and other imports.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: transport and logistics
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Hauling on roads and rivers; shuttles at spacer tech. Scales with road connectivity (#39).

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: hospitality and recreation
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Taverns, lodging, entertainment. Consumes food, drink and drugs; grows with wealth and traffic.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: finance and markets
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Silver, credit and market-making. Only appears in wealthy, urban, connected regions.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: healthcare
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Doctors and hospitals. Consumes medicine; lowers mortality.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: education and research
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Schools and research benches. The sector that moves people up the education ladder.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: slave trade
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Buying and selling people. Exists only where stratification allows it; the Imperium's underclass supply.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: garrison
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Standing forces defending the region. Consumes armaments and food; produces nothing.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: raiding and piracy
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Living off others. The raider archetype's whole economy: loot replaces production.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: mercenaries
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Soldiers for hire. Exported labour that returns silver.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: administration
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Governance, tax, record-keeping. Larger and more stratified societies need more of it.

RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.label: clergy
RegionsAndSocieties.Economy.EconomicSect.description: Priests, rituals, temples. Scales with ideology strength; the institutional side of belief.
